instruction: Set up a global play/pause hotkey for VLC that works even when VLC is not the active window.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting a global play/pause hotkey in VLC by configuring the global-key-play-pause setting in the VLC configuration file. The existing metric function check_global_key_play_pause validates this setting. Default is unset (empty), so the agent must set it to a key binding.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC config file from OS-specific paths (vlc.py:35-61)
Metric correctly checks if global-key-play-pause setting is configured: '0' if empty (not set), '1' if non-empty (set)
Expected value '1' correctly represents that a global hotkey should be configured
Complete coverage: instruction requires configuring a global play/pause hotkey, evaluator verifies the setting is configured
